=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12-187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode cleanup is deferred until Step 1 reads the plan to obtain the Source issue identifier, but the cleanup section header still asserts that every stage session runs cleanup in Step 0.
  WHY: An unattended session following the instructions literally may attempt cleanup in Step 0, before Step 1 has resolved the identifier. This causes the cleanup to fail or be skipped, leaving the stopped session unarchived and re-introducing the bug this PR aims to fix.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:103-190 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: No failure-handling path is defined for transient errors in set_session_title or mcp__github__issue_read.
  WHY: A rename failure can leave the session with its old title (which the cleanup will not match), and a label-read failure can skip archival without surfacing an error, leaving idle sessions visible after the issue resumes.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The lint check (tests/inventory_parity.py) must pass for the PR to merge; scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py must be documented in the docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section or explicitly exempted in tests/inventory_exemptions.txt.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not touch docs/INVENTORY.md to include scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py; tests/inventory_parity.py fails on this PR head, blocking the merge.
- requirement: Ensure issue-mode cleanup actually runs on a /reclarify resume after Step 1 reads the plan and the Source issue: identifier is available.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and workflow-templates twin)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Step 1 contains no reference to the Zombie-checker cleanup, and the cleanup section header at line 187 still reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene" with no exception for issue-mode timing. The new Step 0 bullet at line 12 describes a deferral but provides no operational hook that fires the cleanup after Step 1.
- requirement: A contract test must pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger's placement after Step 1 reads the plan and verify the cleanup section header distinguishes issue-mode timing from the strict step-0 invariant.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The existing test only checks text-string existence. It does not assert placement relative to Step 1, the cleanup header timing, or pin the deferred cleanup to an operational hook after Step 1.
- requirement: When Step 1 reads a plan that lacks a Source issue: header line, the issue-mode cleanup must either log/report the skip or be documented as an intentional no-op so an operator can distinguish a project-mode resume from cleanup that was silently dropped.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The new bullet at line 12 says "a plan without that line skips this" but never instructs the session to log/report the skip; the cleanup-section report line at line 191 only fires when m is computable, so a project-mode resume with no Source issue: line never produces a count or log.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
